title: Parallel Tempering for Diffusion-Based Combinatorial Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.37323v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Discrete diffusion models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for solving combinatorial optimization (CO) problems on graphs by learning to sample high-quality solutions. A common inference-time approach is to generate multiple candidate solutions independently and return the best-performing sample, improving solution quality at the expense of an increase in computational cost. In this work, we introduce PT-Denoise, an inference-time procedure that allows these concurrent denoising trajectories to interact through parallel tempering, without requiring retraining or fine-tuning of the underlying denoiser. Our method assigns a temperature to each diffusion process and allows processes to swap temperatures based on their relative performance. This dynamically reallocates promising, low-energy trajectories to colder, more concentrated sampling regimes while allowing higher-energy states to escape local minima through randomized exploration.

translated_title: 基于扩散模型的组合优化的并行回火方法
translated_abstract: 离散扩散模型已成为解决图上组合优化（CO）问题的强大范式，它通过学习采样高质量解来实现。一种常见的推理时方法是独立生成多个候选解并返回其中表现最佳的样本，从而以增加计算成本为代价来提高解的质量。在这项工作中，我们提出了PT-Denoise，这是一种推理时程序，它允许这些并发的去噪轨迹通过并行回火进行交互，而无需对底层去噪器进行重新训练或微调。我们的方法为每个扩散过程分配一个温度，并允许这些过程根据其相对性能交换温度。这样可以动态地将有前景的低能量轨迹重新分配到更冷、更集中的采样区域，同时让较高能量的状态通过随机探索逃离局部极小值。
tldr: 提出PT-Denoise方法，在无需重新训练或微调去噪器的情况下，通过并行回火使并发的扩散去噪轨迹之间交换温度并相互交互，动态地将有前景的低能量轨迹引导至更集中的采样区域，从而更高效地采样出高质量解以解决图上的组合优化问题。
en_tdlr: PT-Denoise is a training-free inference-time procedure that enables concurrent diffusion denoising trajectories to interact via parallel tempering by swapping temperatures based on relative performance, dynamically reallocating promising low-energy trajectories to colder sampling regimes and thereby sampling higher-quality solutions for graph-based combinatorial optimization.
